purpose: Short fixed-schedule CPA+FIA versus CPA+FIA+deterministic-bin-and-radius pilot
weight_calibration: Public-only gradient norms at shared initial candidate; fixed throughout both branches
quantization_scale_floor: median of strictly-positive public row steps; original cells and final exact codes unchanged
labels: Private; initialize both from public starting classifier applied to common warmup images; update hybrid logits through observation only
arm_difference: Adding the complete bin-plus-radius objective, including its image and private-label gradients
evaluation: Same final artifacts, all16, offline MSE-Hungarian once per arm then PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS; final exact codes and radius, soft/hard fit; no private early stopping or candidate selection
decision_rule: Report signed differences in image and observation metrics without a success cutoff; mixed directions are inconclusive. Single pilot cannot establish general superiority or impossibility. Equal iterations and shared schedule, not equal wall-clock time.
